blocks.text: Abbotsford West homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Abbotsford West, October 2026. Detached houses: 115 listed at month end and 21 sold in October, a sales ratio of 18% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 215 listed at month end and 23 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 76 sold over 5 months against an average of 134.8 listed, about 8.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 21 sold. Condos and townhomes: 109 sold over 5 months against an average of 215.0 listed, about 9.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 26 sold.

faq.a: Catchment is set by address in the SD34 School Locator. Recorded runs for three west-side addresses show the area splits: 3614 Clearbrook Road returns Clearbrook Elementary → Colleen and Gordie Howe Middle → W.J. Mouat Secondary; 2990 Oriole Crescent returns John MacLure Community School → Colleen and Gordie Howe Middle → W.J. Mouat Secondary; and 3433 Firhill Drive returns Blue Jay Elementary → Eugene Reimer Middle → Rick Hansen Secondary (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01). Run any specific address before relying on a school.

faq.a: Parts of the rural west and southwest are in the ALR; in the A1 zone the minimum subdivision lot area is 8.0 ha and in A2 it is 16.0 ha, and an added residence in the ALR must also meet the ALC limits — principal residence 500 m² or less, suite only inside it, additional residence 90 m² or less (40 ha or less) or 186 m² or less (over 40 ha) — as well as City zoning.
faq.q: Is land on the rural west edge in the Agricultural Land Reserve?
